BiblicalUsage: Siccuth is the idolatrous booth Israel carried in the wilderness, the shrine of their star god. Amos names it in the judgment against a people who worshipped what they had made. The name appears once, and the sin it names is the reason for the exile.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Siccuth shows how quickly worship goes wrong when people build their own gods, and Amos names it plainly so no one can miss it.
